Name: Haley Portraits for Seasonal Outfits
Author: JustYourAverageWeirdo
Description:
I adore the Seasonal Outfits mod, but my first ever Stardew waifu had her eyebrows done and it is NAWT the look--she looks more grumpy/pouty in my opinion, which doesn't suit her character growth once you get to know her more. In that way, I missed the style of her vanilla portrait.

**DISCLAIMER**
I do not own this art. For all of the images, I simply tweaked her eyebrows using Paint.NET. 

I probably won't ever update this mod because it's just a little add-in I did for myself but decided to share for those who noticed and missed Haley's look like I did. This is also my first ever mod I'm sharing, so thank you for being understanding <3


TO INSTALL:
﻿- Download Seasonal Outfits and all it's requirements
﻿- Download and Unzip my mod
﻿- Locate the correct folder in you mods folder (>Stardew Valley -> Mods -> [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters -> assets -> Portraits -> Haley)
﻿ ﻿(NOTE: my mod does nothing for the [-> assets -> Characters -> Haley] folder. That folder is for sprites only. My mod is specifically for her Portrait)
﻿- Replace the Haley folder with my mod folder (make sure the name is just "Haley")
﻿- Enjoy!
